name: @projexlight/sdk-dispatch
summary: Dispatch engine for field-service work: a per-tenant queue of dispatchable tasks, a router that selects + sequences them into routes, and a hand-off contract that lets sdk-assignment claim a task atomically. Backbone of any field-operations blueprint — couples upstream intake (storm, support, scheduled visits) to downstream tech execution.

events.name: dispatch.task.enqueued.v1
events.description: New task queued for dispatch; carries SLA + skill requirements + geo.

events.name: dispatch.task.dispatched.v1
events.description: Task handed off to sdk-assignment (assignment authority took the row).

events.name: dispatch.task.completed.v1
events.description: Tech reported task complete; closes the dispatch loop.

events.name: dispatch.task.cancelled.v1
events.description: Task cancelled before completion (customer, weather, dependency).

events.name: dispatch.route.materialized.v1
events.description: Router emitted a fresh route ordering for a tech's day.

models.description: Per-tenant queue: status (pending/dispatched/done), priority, sla_deadline, skill_tag.
Canonical dispatchable unit: customer_ref, address, geo, skill_required, materials_estimate.
Per-tech ordered route for a date: ordered_task_ids, drive_time_min_estimate.

hooks.name: enqueueTask
hooks.description: Service entry — accepts a task spec, inserts to dispatch.queue, emits .enqueued.v1.

hooks.name: materializeRoute
hooks.description: Router pass — for a tech + date, pick + sequence queued tasks into a drive-optimized route. Idempotent per (tech, date).

hooks.name: completeTask
hooks.description: Tech reports completion; closes the row + emits .completed.v1.

hooks.name: cancelTask
hooks.description: Cancel a task with a reason code. Refuses if already in flight (use rescind path instead).

hooks.name: startWorker
hooks.description: Background worker: pulls .enqueued.v1 + .storm.spawned.v1 + customer-request events into the queue. Safe to leave running in dev.

scenarios.title: Customer call center logs a service request → tech queue
scenarios.when_to_use: Inbound work intake. Call-center agent files a job; sdk-dispatch puts it in the queue with the SLA pulled from the customer contract.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Task in dispatch.queue with status='pending'. Router pass within DISPATCH_ROUTER_CADENCE_SEC picks it up + assigns to the next route.

scenarios.title: Storm spawns 200 tasks at once
scenarios.when_to_use: Reactive worker on storm.event.spawned.v1 — each affected service polygon spawns a batch of dispatchable tasks for restoration / triage / damage assessment.
scenarios.expected_outcome: 200 tasks added with priority='critical'. Router pass interleaves them with the existing standard queue + materializes new routes for impacted techs.

scenarios.title: Router materializes a tech's day at 06:00
scenarios.when_to_use: Pre-shift batch — pick + sequence the tech's queued tasks into a drive-optimized route. Idempotent so running again at 06:30 is safe.
scenarios.expected_outcome: dispatch.route row with ordered_task_ids + drive_time_min_estimate. Emits .route.materialized.v1 to drive the tech mobile app + the customer-facing ETA notifications via sdk-notification.

scenarios.title: Assignment authority claims a task atomically
scenarios.when_to_use: sdk-assignment claims a row out of the queue (lease + ack). Dispatch flips status to 'dispatched' on the .claimed.v1 event so the queue cannot double-allocate.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Task row status='dispatched'. Subsequent enqueueTask calls for the same customer/SLA cannot re-add (idempotency key check). Emits .dispatched.v1 to close the handoff.

scenarios.title: Tech reports completion; sdk-evidence captures the proof
scenarios.when_to_use: Tech finishes the job; mobile app calls completeTask + uploads proof-of-work photos via sdk-evidence. The completion event drives billing + customer notification.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Row marked complete; emits .completed.v1 which sdk-billing + sdk-notification react to (invoice draft + customer 'job complete' SMS). Closes the dispatch loop.

compliance_posture.notes: Customer address + phone are PII — masked in operator UIs unless the persona has 'dispatch.read.customer-contact' permission. Completion events feed sdk-billing — SOX-relevant once revenue ties to the .completed.v1 timestamp. Storm-driven mass enqueues are rate-capped to keep the queue from drowning sdk-assignment's lease pool.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per task enqueued (storm-batches priced at a lower rate)
